title: The Hedgehog Who Didn't Say Hello
synopsis: Danny takes a missed greeting personally but learns that Kate was occupied in the wind.

related_resources.reason: Describes emerging perspective-taking in the preceding age window; does not set an age-3 performance expectation.
Emerging peer social skills and need for adult guidance. Not a directive to share any possession at any moment.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: There might be more than one reason for a missed hello, she said.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: Other people may have explanations for their actions that we do not know yet.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: Age-related emerging social awareness; no expectation of advanced social inference.

rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: A concrete physical explanation revises the first interpretation.
